text:
QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` (`:566-576`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` itself, using a mutex-wrapped variant when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init calls the setter, but it never says it is the only in-tree user. It even says the sample programs "use this path," which leaves the "only user" claim unstated.
